name: ToolbarColorPicker
intent: Grouped colour swatches for a toolbar, with an optional no-fill option.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected color (controlled). Empty string `""` means "no fill".

props.name: groups
props.description: Swatch groups. Defaults to a standard-colors + grays palette.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of swatches per row. Default 10.

props.name: allowNoColor
props.description: Show the "No fill" option (value becomes `""`). Default true.

props.name: noColorLabel
props.description: Label for the no-fill option. Default "No fill".

props.name: allowCustom
props.description: Show the custom OS color picker ("More colors…"). Default true.

props.name: customLabel
props.description: Label for the custom-picker button. Default "More colors…".

props.name: recentColors
props.description: Recently-used custom colors shown in their own row.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger. Default "Color".

props.name: preview
props.description: How the current color previews next to `icon`. `"bar"` (default) shows it as a bar beneath the icon (PowerPoint style); `"swatch"` shows a square swatch to the right of the icon. Ignored when no `icon` is set (always a swatch).

props.name: align
props.description: Popover alignment relative to the trigger.

props.name: compact
props.description: Compact mode: the popover is swatches only — no group labels, no-fill/custom rendered as swatches (the custom swatch opens the OS picker), and no text.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use ToolbarColorPicker when you need to collect user input or allow users to make selections. This component provides a consistent interaction pattern that users will find familiar and accessible.

ToolbarColorPicker should be used within forms or interactive interfaces where user data collection is required. Ensure proper labeling and validation feedback for accessibility. Avoid using this component for read-only or display-only content.

anatomy.description: ToolbarColorPicker is composed of the following parts:
